A6Analogue

VCO

Analogue oscillator with four waveforms

Analogue oscillator with 1 V/oct tracking. Triangle, saw, square and sine are available at the same time, each on its own output.

  • Coarse tuning over about 8 octaves, fine tuning ± 1 semitone
  • Linear FM, pulse-width modulation and hard sync
  • Temperature-compensated exponential converter
Width10 HP · 50.6 mm
Height3 U · 128.5 mm
Jacks8
Knobs5
Power± 12 V (Eurorack bus)
